gen-vast-shadow-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Flat, contrast-free letters with a tall mean line give Vast Shadow its vintage, hard-to-miss face. Carrois Gothic SC is the quieter one, a sans with open curve endings and capitals and lowercase sitting close in height.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-chivo: Vintage swagger comes first, with Vast Shadow cutting every stroke to one width and leaving no thick-to-thin shading. Chivo is the plain sans partner, its lowercase packed up toward the caps and daylight showing through every curve.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-chocolate-classical-s: Chocolate Classical Sans brings a sizable lowercase and a broad-nibbed pen stroke that never curls shut, modern and professional in tone. Vast Shadow sits above it, vintage and loud.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-comme: Retro and loud, then smooth. Vast Shadow is best at turning heads with stout, even diagonals and horizontals, while Comme does the quiet work, a plain sans whose big lowercase bodies run without clogging.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-cossette-texte: Vintage charm leads here, thanks to Vast Shadow and its tall mean line and generous side spacing. And Cossette Texte keeps the page easy to move through, a sans with wide-eyed lowercase e shapes and a prominent x-height.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-duru-sans: Eye-catching is the right word for Vast Shadow, where every diagonal is as stout as every upright. But Duru Sans is the plain sans that does the steady reading, with wide openings on small letters and ascenders that barely show.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-fragment-mono: Vast Shadow is the showpiece, cutting every stroke to one width and spacing its letters with plenty of room on either side. Fragment Mono is the structured monospace, with a tall waist line and letters lined up like nails on a ruler.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-fresca: Fresca reads smooth and modern, with no calligraphic thinning anywhere. Its connected counters and short ascenders above big bowls would carry a long page without tiring the eye, while Vast Shadow stays up top being vintage.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-funnel-sans: Vintage and hard to ignore, Vast Shadow stands tall with every stroke cut to one width. Funnel Sans follows it with a clean, professional sans, its stroke widths staying put and its lowercase e opened wide.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-gafata: Vintage shapes, loud and flat. Gafata runs a tall band of lowercase under short stalks, with wide-eyed e shapes that would keep a long passage moving, while Vast Shadow keeps vertical and horizontal strokes at identical weight.
